settings.question: Why should I commission this studio?
settings.answer: We specialize in VTuber model creation and custom illustrations, offering high-quality results at budget-friendly prices. Our team of experienced artists is at your service.

settings.question: How do I start a project?
settings.answer: Simply contact us through the Contact section and ask for a quotation.

settings.question: Is there any form to fill in for commissions?
settings.answer: Once you placed the order, a requirement list would be sent for you to fill in.

settings.question: How much do your services cost?
settings.answer: Our pricing is detailed in our Price List section. If you have a specific project in mind, feel free to contact us for a custom quote.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept payments via PayPal, or you can place your order on our Fiverr and VGen page.

settings.question: Do you offer payment plans?
settings.answer: We prefer all payments are made in full upfront, but for clients with special needs, we do offer a two-part payment plan: 50% upfront to place the order and 50% before rigging begins.

settings.question: What's included in a VTuber model package?
settings.answer: Our VTuber packages typically include a fully rigged model, optional poses and expression toggles, and custom designs tailored to your specifications.

settings.question: Can I request a certain artist and rigger for my model?
settings.answer: We assign the artists and riggers based on their availability and their specialities. Clients who want to select specific artists or riggers may incur additional fees and longer wait times.

settings.question: Do you offer art only or rig only commissions?
settings.answer: We currently don't accept art-only or rig-only commissions, as we focus on providing complete art + rig packages to ensure the best quality and consistency.

settings.question: How long does it take to create a VTuber model?
settings.answer: Please check our Queue Time section for reference.

settings.question: What happens after I place the order?
settings.answer: Our project manager would be communicating with you on your preferred platform as a bridge between you and the assigned artist and rigger for updates and feedback.

settings.question: Can I request revisions on my VTuber model?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer revisions during the design and rigging phases. Please check our process of work on our TOS section for reference.
